name: cortexdb
description: Local-first AI memory and knowledge graph for Codex: vector search, RAG, GraphRAG, RDF/SPARQL/RDFS/SHACL, scoped agent memory, and corpus-to-graph workflows — bundled as a skill plus live MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first AI memory and knowledge graph
interface.longDescription: CortexDB is a pure-Go, single-file AI memory and knowledge graph library on SQLite. This plugin bundles the CortexDB skill plus an MCP server exposing live tools for knowledge save/search, scoped memory, RDF/SPARQL knowledge graphs, SHACL validation, and GraphRAG context building.
